package.name: auv_controller_MPPI
package.description: MPPI (Model Predictive Path Integral) controller for the 8-thruster 6-DOF RoboSub AUV "barracuda2". Contains: forward dynamics model (Fossen), thruster allocation (6x8), MPPI solver, cost function, control-sequence executor, ROS 2 controller node, training mission node, training data collector and offline system identification.
